TrainingRecord.title: Training record
TrainingRecord.description: One training one employee is planned for or followed, as the personnel file shows it: whether they attended, until when the certificate counts, what it cost and any study-cost agreement. The course itself lives in the learning app; this is the HR fact (talent-training-and-lms D1).

registreren-gevolgd.description: HR registers that the employee attended. A training with a competence code then grants or extends that competence.

registreren-niet-gevolgd.description: HR registers that the employee did not attend. It can still be registered as attended later.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: Who is planned for or followed this training.

title.title: Training
title.description: What the training is called, for example BHV herhaling.

plannedOn.title: Planned on
plannedOn.description: The day the training takes place, or starts.

status.title: Status
status.description: Whether the employee has attended the training.
status.x-notes: Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (gepland -> gevolgd or niet-gevolgd; niet-gevolgd -> gevolgd). A record from learniq is created as gevolgd.

completedOn.title: Completed on
completedOn.description: The day the employee finished the training. Left empty, the planned day is used once it is registered as attended.

validityMonths.title: Valid for (months)
validityMonths.description: How many months the certificate counts after the training. Used to fill in the valid until date once it is registered as attended.
validityMonths.x-notes: talent-training-and-lms D1 addition at build time: a planned group course knows its validity in months, not its end date, so TrainingRecordListener derives validUntil = completedOn + validityMonths on the gevolgd write when validUntil is empty.

validUntil.title: Valid until
validUntil.description: The last day the certificate counts. Leave empty when it does not expire.

competenceCode.title: Competence
competenceCode.description: The competence this training grants once attended, for example bhv. Leave empty when it grants none.

costEur.title: Cost
costEur.description: What the training costs the employer, in euros.

studiekostenbeding.title: Study-cost agreement
studiekostenbeding.description: Whether the employee agreed to repay part of the cost when they leave early.

terugbetalingsregeling.title: Repayment terms
terugbetalingsregeling.description: What the employee repays and when, as agreed. humaniq does not calculate the amount.

sourceRef.title: Source reference
sourceRef.description: The id of the certificate in the learning app or platform this record came from.
sourceRef.x-notes: For source learniq, the Credential uuid; LearniqCredentialListener uses it to write one record per credential (D4).

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: The administration this record belongs to.
administrationId.x-notes: Multi-administratie scoping; filled from the employee by TrainingRecordListener when left empty.

objects.title: Master human resource management
objects.terugbetalingsregeling: Bij vertrek binnen een jaar na afronding 100 procent terug, binnen twee jaar 50 procent.
